Chapter 676: Chapter 11: The Battle A Billion Years Ago (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

“The Great War where Supreme Beings were heavily wounded…” Lin Yuan’s heart trembled a bit.

Having briefly escaped the shackles of the River of Time and witnessing those Supreme Beings’ true bodies at the ‘shore,’ Lin Yuan was all too aware of how powerful Twelfth-Rank Life was.

What would a war that could heavily wound Supreme Beings be like?

However, it also increasingly highlighted the preciousness of those treasures that had fallen from outside of the universe.

How could Supreme Beings possibly engage in fierce battles with each other if it were not for the sight of actual benefits and advantages?

“The black planet… must be one of the many treasures that fell… because of the killing among Supreme Beings, many treasures scattered.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

...

“And these treasures are naturally capable of concealing their presence; even Supreme Beings wouldn’t be able to detect them unless they were quite close…”

Lin Yuan pondered silently in his heart.

He couldn’t help feeling that his luck was indeed quite good.

After such a long time, most of the scattered treasures had been found. Even if there were any overlooked, they would certainly be extremely rare, hidden in very inconspicuous places.

Yet, he had managed to find one.

“Respected Scholar Yuan, Eighth-Level Citizen, this black planet involves secrets from before the birth of human civilization. Would you consider handing it over for human civilization to explore in exchange for a large number of Merit Points?” The Goddess of Wisdom’s voice came once more.

This was the standard procedure. Whenever a human civilization Evolver discovered special planets or ancient remains in an uncharted Star Domain,

the Goddess of Wisdom would make a suggestion.

The discoverer could agree or refuse.

“How many Merit Points could I get?” Lin Yuan asked with interest.

If the Merit Points were sufficient, he wouldn’t mind handing over the black planet to human civilization.

After all, it was just a matter of price.

“Preliminary assessment, valued at five hundred million Merit Points,” the Goddess of Wisdom said.

“Five hundred million Merit Points?” Lin Yuan inwardly exclaimed in surprise.

That was indeed a substantial number of Merit Points. How much did Lin Yuan’s crafted Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter fetch in Merit Points?

Not even one hundred million Merit Points.

Plus the bloodline cultivation path, in the end, brought in just two hundred million Merit Points.

And now, a mere black planet was valued at five hundred million Merit Points.

After all, not even a Galaxy Master-class Rare Treasure like the World Tree, which was of Eleven-Star quality, totaled five hundred million Merit Points.

“Five hundred million Merit Points… Though substantial, they are meaningless to me,” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

Ascending from a Ninth-Level Citizen to a Ninth Rank requires one billion Merit Points.

Even if Lin Yuan had an additional five hundred million Merit Points, becoming a Ninth-Level Citizen was still far out of reach.

And as for trading Merit Points for those Rare Treasures recorded by human civilization? Currently, with Lin Yuan’s cultivation progressing smoothly, he lacked nothing and didn’t have a great desire for treasures.

Moreover, most treasures could be purchased using Cosmic Crystals by someone like Lin Yuan, with his privileges among humans.

There was no need to squander Merit Points.

“I’ll consider it,”

Lin Yuan casually responded to the Goddess of Wisdom.

He planned to wait until he had advanced to Tenth Rank and comprehended the corresponding Fusion Rules before personally exploring and then deciding whether to sell the black planet to human civilization.

After all, the black planet was there.

Given the Goddess of Wisdom’s estimate, the price would not go down no matter when he sold it, unless Lin Yuan took away important treasures from inside the black planet, causing its value to plummet significantly.

…

A month later.

Lin Yuan was cultivating when he received the news.

Nalan, the former Deputy Tower Master of Xia You Evolution Tower, had stepped into Tier 11.

An Eleventh-Rank Evolver was the strongest force under the human civilization’s Supreme Beings.

The birth of every Eleventh-Rank Evolver was a golden age for human civilization, meaning the chance of a tenth Supreme Being emerging was another step closer.

Thus, every Eleventh-Rank Evolver’s ascension was celebrated.

At that time, many forces of human civilization would come to offer their congratulations, and even Different Species with no particular enmity toward human civilization would send strong beings to celebrate.

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan, of course, was also invited to participate in Deputy Tower Master Nalan’s celebration.

“There sure are a lot of people?” Lin Yuan appeared in a virtual world specially created for the occasion. It was a star system, and the countless guests who came to offer their congratulations were all arranged to sit on different planets,

Given Lin Yuan’s status and strength, he naturally could sit on the most central planet.

“Galaxy Master.”

“Galaxy Master, you’ve come too?” the Black Star Lord, Lustrous Star Master, and other Grade A Tenth Rank, seeing Lin Yuan, immediately waved.

“See, didn’t I speculate correctly? Deputy Tower Master Nalan really broke through to Tier 11,” Black Star Lord immediately started speaking.

Some time ago, after hearing that Deputy Tower Master Nalan had resigned from his position, he speculated with Lin Yuan and others that there would be another Eleventh-Rank Evolver in human civilization.

Lin Yuan smiled as he casually chatted with Black Star Lord and a few others.

A moment later.

Black Star Lord glanced at the central position of the planet, “It’s about time, we should go and offer our congratulations to Deputy Tower Master Nalan.”

As the main character of the celebration, Deputy Tower Master Nalan was at the center of the planet, chatting with the important guests who came to celebrate.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan and the others immediately stood up and flew towards the central position.

“Congratulations to Nalan for stepping into Tier 11,” Black Star Lord, Lustrous Star Master, and others immediately began to offer their congratulations.

As a small circle of Grade A Tenth Rank, Black Star Lord, Lustrous Star Master were among the closest to the Eleventh Rank level.

Even before Deputy Tower Master Nalan had broken through to Tier 11, they were equals.

However, now that Nalan had stepped into Tier 11, he was well above them.

“Hahaha, I look forward to you also stepping into Tier 11,” Deputy Tower Master Nalan, with a smile on his face, was clearly in a good mood.

“Galaxy Master,” Deputy Tower Master Nalan saw Lin Yuan and immediately called out enthusiastically, “After my breakthrough, the person I wanted to see the most was you, Galaxy Master. But I’ve been too busy.”

Deputy Tower Master Nalan looked at Lin Yuan with a beaming smile, treating him quite differently from how he treated Black Star Lord and the other Grade A Tenth Rank.

“Hmm?”

Black Star Lord and Lustrous Star Master exchanged glances. They vaguely sensed that Deputy Tower Master Nalan valued the Galaxy Master a lot and was treating him as an equal, a fellow Evolver on the same level.
